list.activeNotDeletable: Executing activity items cannot be deleted.

dialogs.cancelDescription: Cancel {{name}}? This immediately marks the queued action as cancelled before execution starts.
dialogs.forceFailDescription: Force fail {{name}}? This immediately marks the running action as failed and releases the active slot without guaranteeing rollback.
dialogs.resumeDescription: Resume {{name}}? This continues the paused action.
dialogs.deleteSelectedDescription: Delete {{count}} selected activity records? This removes them from history.
dialogs.deleteOneDescription: Delete {{name}}? This removes the activity record from history.

create.title: Create Deployment
create.description: Define and launch a new application deployment on a target server.
create.helpDescription: Short answers for the most common questions during deployment creation.
create.noPreflight: No pre-flight result for the current inputs yet.
create.preflightTooltip: Check surfaces name, port, and disk issues before deployment.
create.whyCheckAnswer: Check runs backend pre-flight validation and can surface blocking issues before an action is created.
create.createRunsValidation: Does Create Deployment run validation again?
create.createRunsValidationAnswer: Yes. The server performs final validation and normalization again when the deployment action is created.
create.warningsQuestion: What should I do if Check reports warnings?
create.warningsAnswer: Review the warnings, decide whether they are acceptable for this target, and then continue with Create Deployment only if the result is acceptable.
create.appNameHelp: Must be unique across the server. Used as compose project name and the app data directory root.
create.targetLocationHelp: The target server where containers will be created and managed.
create.searchServers: Search servers by name or host
create.noServersMatch: No servers match the current search.
create.templateLocked: Open the target application from App Store and start deployment there. This flow no longer supports switching apps inside the template form.
create.repositoryDescription: Provide the Git repository coordinates. The backend clones, extracts the compose file, and resolves it into an install payload.
create.buildTargetHelp: Choose which compose service should use the image built from the uploaded source package. Single-service compose files are selected automatically.
create.buildTargetDescription: Activation target for the local application image
create.selectedServiceReplaced: The selected service image will be replaced by the locally built application image.
create.singleServiceAuto: Single-service compose detected. The application image target is selected automatically.
create.advancedHelp: Additional deployment parameters resolved and normalized by the backend before execution.
create.estimatedAppDiskHelp: Optional estimate used by preflight when checking whether the selected target has enough free space.
create.estimatedAppDiskTemplateHelp: Optional for manual inputs. Template mode prefills this from the app metadata and still allows an override before preflight.
create.noAdvancedInputs: No advanced inputs for this template.
create.databasePasswordHint: Auto-generated by default; change only if you need a fixed credential.
create.exposureRulesHelp: Domain, path, or port publication intent for reverse-proxy configuration.
create.secretBackedInputsHelp: Sensitive values managed through the backend secret store, never exposed in plain text.
create.dockerCheckingDescription: Reviewing Docker and Compose prerequisites for this target.
create.dockerReadyDescription: Docker Engine and Compose are available on this target.
create.dockerNeedsAttentionDescription: Open prerequisites to repair Docker before deploying.
